metrics.api_ms: monotonic elapsed before create invocation to API/CLI return; not guest readiness
metrics.native_ready_ms: create invocation to client receipt of native shell random marker on first exec stream
metrics.python_print_ms: same create invocation to client receipt of complete Python random marker plus newline; includes interpreter startup
metrics.internal_ready_ms: server log guest-ready milestone, only if observable and correlated by sandbox ID
metrics.native_to_python_ms: client-observed marker interval, includes buffering/transport; not pure guest interpreter CPU time
metrics.pool_before: state-based gate before timed request, recorded outside foreground
metrics.pool_after: time after delete returns until pool is full and quiescent; 50 ms polling resolution
metrics.refill_events: server work duration and replacement latency by retired sandbox ID where available

preparation.guest_start_command: native sleep or envd, no Python
preparation.warmup: disposable sandbox; never recaptured into template
preparation.image_import_template_capture_and_pool_p: separate evidence; failed preparation attempts retained

pool_modes.kuasar-mlink: full-warm, profile-prepared L2 slots, full snapshot page cache, hot-ready-workers=0
pool_modes.kuasar-fork: generic snapshot CoW resource pool, full guest/network readiness before lease; no per-image VM pool
pool_modes.kuasar-off: native snapshot restore, prefetch off; equivalent pool/cache mode not exposed
pool_modes.kuasar-uffd: native UFFD snapshot restore, prefetch off; equivalent pool/cache mode not exposed
pool_modes.cube: native template snapshot restore; equivalent pool/cache mode not exposed
pool_modes.agentenv: native template snapshot restore; equivalent pool/cache mode not exposed

scope_note: Align startup-mode resource configuration and preparation/readiness accounting, not a claim that six unlike native architectures implement all six reference cache/restore modes. Unsupported modes are N/A. No global drop_caches or unrelated process changes.
resource_profile: For 50 simultaneous sandboxes, expand configurable pools from 2 to 64 after startup measurements and report preparation separately. Resource results use this larger profile.
statistics: All 50 measured rows required; no trimming or best-round selection. Median uses midpoint; P95/P99 use nearest rank. Warmup retained as row 00 and excluded.
limitations: PSS excludes unmapped host cache and kernel memory
Fork application writes use guest RAM overlay and persistent pause/resume is unsupported; do not infer durable-data IO superiority
Phase timers can overlap and must not be summed blindly
Host is shared; record load without killing other workloads

languages.metrics: interpreter_print_ms and native_to_interpreter_ms; Python legacy aliases only for Python
languages.preparation: same image digest across products for each language; no interpreter execution in template preparation
